description: This file defines the LLMClient class, which provides an abstraction layer for interfacing with external Large Language Model providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic. It includes methods for sending chat prompts and handling API calls, with support for fallback/mock responses.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: A minimal abstraction layer for interacting with external LLM providers, supporting different service APIs and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: __init__(self, provider: str | None = None, api_key: str | None = None, model: str | None = None)
methods.description: Initializes the LLMClient with optional provider, api_key, and model, defaulting to project settings when not provided.

methods.name: str chat(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], tools: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None)
methods.description: Sends a chat-style prompt to the configured LLM provider and returns the assistant's response.

methods.name: str _call_openai(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Private method to call OpenAI's chat completion API and retrieve a response.

methods.name: str _call_anthropic(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Private method to call Anthropic's chat API and retrieve a response.
